title: 2.01 / Spectrum Logo
slide_intent: Show which parts of a mark carry the name and which suggest action, so designers preserve both recognition and meaning.
strategic_value: The dark wordmark and bright arrow can connect a familiar name with engagement and forward movement.
demonstration: An enlarged logo is annotated with wordmark construction, visual dominance, arrow function and two Pantone assignments.
practical_value: Preserve the relationship between the custom wordmark and terminal arrow when selecting approved artwork.

content_islands.name: Heading and rationale
content_islands.spec: Place the title left and the explanation of the forward icon at upper right.

content_islands.name: Annotated logo
content_islands.spec: Center the large dark blue wordmark and cyan arrow, with fine cyan leaders connecting component notes and color labels.

ingredient.name: Spectrum wordmark and arrow
ingredient.role: Identify the brand and punctuate it with a forward cue.
ingredient.application: Use the approved custom wordmark with Pantone 540 C lettering and a Pantone 3005 C arrow.
ingredient.scope: The 2017 primary logo. This page explains the existing artwork rather than authorizing reconstruction.
